title: Foo Bar S3 Initial Load
description: Load a manifest-selected S3-style object prefix into a typed ClickHouse orders table. Handle mixed CSV and JSONL files, environment-provided S3 credentials, a replayed object that must be ignored, and verification against the manifest.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must implement an initial load from S3-style source files into ClickHouse, preserve typed order fields, and prove the loaded table matches the source manifest without duplicate re-ingest.

tasks.description: Create a typed ClickHouse destination table for the historical orders export.
Load only manifest-approved CSV and JSONL objects from the S3-style prefix into the destination table.
Validate row counts, checksums, and duplicate handling against the source manifest.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse is installed but not pre-started. A deterministic S3-style bucket prefix is seeded under /data/s3 with a manifest, three loadable objects, and one replayed object that must be ignored.
